package.name: aav_mpc_lag
package.description: mpc_lag_rs in Rust (rclrs): aav_track's lag-aware MPC (mpc_lag), ported: it plans the steering and the set speed through the car's own lags (the spine's speed loop, throttle, brake, the steering motor and linkage, dead times). A challenger beside the Python one (navigation.launch.py tracker:=mpc_lag_rs): it serves follow_path in controller_server's place and publishes cmd_vel_nav. Says /drivers/nav/lag_aware (latched) so ego's lead stays off.
